subject.title: fix(queue): exact-review runs report failure when the queue already owns the outcome

question: Does `POST /internal/exact-review/complete` guarantee that each of the four claim-side 409 codes means the requested outcome is already terminally recorded or safely superseded?
rationale: The repository workflow can show that the current run fails on 409, but only the durable queue’s completion contract can establish whether making that response green preserves recovery and reconciliation guarantees.

options.title: Verify terminal completion semantics
options.body: Confirm the endpoint contract with a focused integration test or controlled live trace, then retain only the conflict codes that prove the completion is safely terminal.

options.title: Land diagnostics only
options.body: Keep 409 completions failing while surfacing status and body output until the queue contract provides a safe terminal-code set.

recommendation.title: Verify terminal completion semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm the endpoint contract with a focused integration test or controlled live trace, then retain only the conflict codes that prove the completion is safely terminal.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the durable queue contract and workflow reliability boundary identified by repository policy.
